maya: quick sync re: onboarding split (ingest vs smoke). thinking ingest = deterministic metadata checks, fast-smoke = behavioral + perf. open question: what must be 100% deterministic at ingest?
javier: ingest should only run non-GPU checks: manifest schema, header parse, tokenizer id, signature. anything requiring model load -> defer.
sasha: +1 but we need an explicit shared contract so teams don't get surprised. publish a short manifest spec.
lin: draft manifest fields (cheap only): name, tokenizer.{type,rev}, shapes, requires_live_load flag, variants list. ingest runs header parse + tokenizer lookup.
maya: for variants (quant/adapters) propose inheritance: base artifact validated fully; variants inherit pass unless runtime quickcheck fails. saves duplicate full-bench cost.
javier: scheduling note: fast-smoke for every ingest is expensive. use priority tiers + probabilistic deep-bench. deterministic ingest checks always run.
sasha: agree on sampling, but compatibility/abi checks must be deterministic on every ingest. those cause runtime 500s if flaky.
bench-bot: queued fast-smoke 12021 for intake-4990012345
ops-bot: intake accepted: id=ingest-4990012345, est_cost=0.12 GPU-min (fast-smoke)
lin: artifacts saved by smoke: manifest, runtime-env (torch/cuda), seed, golden_inputs, diff-summary, kernel/quant flags. these are critical for repro.
maya: RBAC: mark models with requires_live_load=true as owner-approve to avoid accidental slow accepts. ops must be able to override during emergencies.
javier: ingest API sketch: POST /ingest {manifest, weights_ref} -> {status:accepted, intake_id, est_cost, gates:[list]}. then fast-smoke subscribes to intake events.
sasha: failure taxonomy idea: MALFORMED (ingest reject) -> ingest owner; TOKENIZER_DRIFT -> model owner; PERFORMANCE_REGRESSION -> bench/fast-smoke owner; SECURITY -> security. We'll map owners in RFC addendum.
maya: next steps: I'll write addendum with manifest schema + API. lin will produce JSON schema example, javier will write sampling knobs, sasha will enumerate owners & failure modes.
lin: I'll drop schema by EOD.
sasha: I'll list owner mapping tomorrow.
javier: I'll draft sampling policy (tiers, probabilities, cost caps).
maya: great, thanks. we'll converge on PR after drafts. :thumbsup:
